task.title: v1.0 Headless Analytics Engine (API, CLI, MCP, TUI)
task.description: Umbrella epic tracking Rotameter v1.0 delivery per PROJECT.md and docs/SPEC-*.md: single static binary, SQLite WAL event-stream + rollups behind Storage traits, /v1/* HTTP contract, collect.js/pixel.gif/Astro+CF Workers SSR, scoped API keys, CLI, stdio read-only MCP, interactive ratatui TUI, multi-arch musl/macOS builds, and 1 vCPU / 1 GB RAM verification gates.

acceptance_criteria: All child v1.0 tickets (RM-2 through RM-17) reach verified status with passing receipts
All engineering budgets in PROJECT.md (< 40 MB idle RSS, < 128 MB peak RSS, <= 1536 B gzip collect.js) pass automated release gates
API, CLI, stdio MCP, and ratatui TUI agree mathematically on all metrics defined in docs/COMPARISON-METRICS.md

task.title: workspace: scaffold Cargo workspace, lint rules and CI purity gates
task.description: Create the 7-crate Cargo workspace (rotameter-core, rotameter-store-sqlite, rotameter-server, rotameter-client, rotameter-mcp, rotameter-tui, rotameter-cli) with MIT OR Apache-2.0 dual licensing, #![forbid(unsafe_code)], workspace clippy/rustfmt lints, core purity check script, and GitHub Actions CI.

acceptance_criteria: All 7 workspace crates compile under cargo check --workspace and cargo test --workspace
LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE exist at repository root and Cargo.toml sets license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
Every application crate enforces #![forbid(unsafe_code)] and denies warnings under cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts/check-core-purity.sh verifies cargo tree -p rotameter-core contains zero tokio, rusqlite, axum, or ratatui dependencies

task.title: core: domain types, URL/referrer/UTM normalization, bot & UA classifiers
task.description: Implement pure-Rust domain models in rotameter-core per SPEC-PRIVACY.md and SPEC-API.md: site/event/query types, URL normalization with allowed_query_keys, UTM extraction, referrer/social/search host normalization and channel classification, Aho-Corasick bot/prefetch filter, and coarse UA/device classifier.

acceptance_criteria: URL normalizer strips fragments and arbitrary query params while preserving utm_* extraction and deterministic sorted site.allowed_query_keys
Referrer normalizer removes self-referrals, collapses known aliases (t.co -> x.com, l.instagram.com -> instagram.com, google.* -> google.com), and assigns channels
Compiled-in bot filter drops Sec-Purpose/Purpose/X-Moz prefetch requests, empty UAs, and known crawlers/scrapers
Unit and property tests cover malformed URLs, path byte limits (512 B), UA parsing, and channel rules with zero non-test panics

task.title: core: HMAC-SHA256 visitor hashing, salt rotation, 30m session LRU and cardinality guard
task.description: Implement privacy-preserving visitor hashing, session tracking, cardinality bounds, and pluggable Storage trait boundaries inside rotameter-core per SPEC-ARCHITECTURE.md and SPEC-PRIVACY.md.

acceptance_criteria: Visitor hasher computes truncated 16-byte HMAC-SHA256 over site_id, client_ip, and user_agent using CSPRNG salts supporting daily, weekly, and monthly rotation
30-minute midnight UTC grace window attaches active sessions across salt rotation without splitting visits or visitors
Bounded 100,000-entry sliding session LRU tracks started_at_ms, last_event_ms, event_count, pageview_count, and sequential seq_in_session
Per-site daily cardinality guard enforces path/referrer/prop caps and routes overflow cleanly into (other)
Defines ControlPlaneStore, EventIngestStore, AnalyticsQueryStore, and StorageCapabilities traits cleanly inside rotameter-core

task.title: store-sqlite: bundled SQLite WAL schema, migrations, interning and batched writer
task.description: Implement rotameter-store-sqlite with bundled rusqlite, WAL PRAGMAs (cache_size=-16000, mmap_size=67108864), numbered forward migrations (0001_initial.sql), dim_strings interning + LRU cache, batched single-transaction BEGIN IMMEDIATE writer, and online VACUUM INTO backup.

acceptance_criteria: Applies exact writer/reader PRAGMAs from SPEC-ARCHITECTURE.md and initializes schema via idempotent forward migrations
dim_strings interner maps (kind, value) to integer IDs backed by a 50,000-entry in-memory LRU cache
EventIngestStore persists events (with monotonic seq_in_session), session upserts, and rollups_hourly/rollups_daily deltas inside one BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction
VACUUM INTO online backup routine produces integrity-verified SQLite snapshots while concurrent reads/writes proceed

task.title: store-sqlite: analytics query engine, rollups, realtime and retention pruner
task.description: Implement AnalyticsQueryStore over SQLite WAL per COMPARISON-METRICS.md and SPEC-API.md: summary, previous_summary, timeseries (hour/day/month in site IANA timezone), breakdown, eq/neq/in/contains/prefix filters, CSV projection, 5-min realtime, raw_retention_days pruner, and site purge.

acceptance_criteria: Computes exact visitors, pageviews, visits, views_per_visit, bounce_rate, avg_visit_duration_ms, entry_page, and exit_page matching COMPARISON-METRICS.md
Supports preset (24h/7d/30d/12m/all) and custom [from, to) ranges, IANA timezone bucketing, compare_previous, sorting, pagination, and eq/neq/in/contains/prefix filters
Realtime query returns 5-minute active visitors, active pages, and 30-minute per-minute pulse
raw_retention_days pruner deletes aged events/sessions while preserving rollups_hourly/rollups_daily; site purge deletes prior to cutoff

task.title: server: axum HTTP core, scoped API key auth, rate limiting and Admin REST API
task.description: Build the Axum HTTP server core, uniform /v1 error envelope, SHA-256 hashed scoped Bearer key middleware (rm_ing_, rm_rd_, rm_adm_), per-IP token-bucket rate limiter, unauthenticated /v1/health, and idempotent /v1/admin/sites/* and /v1/admin/keys/* routes.

acceptance_criteria: Every 4xx/5xx error returns { "error": { "code", "message", "details?" } } in snake_case JSON
Auth middleware enforces rm_ing_, rm_rd_, and rm_adm_ scopes via SHA-256 key hashes without logging plaintext tokens
PUT/GET/DELETE /v1/admin/sites/{id} and POST/GET/DELETE /v1/admin/keys behave idempotently for CLI and IaC callers
GET /v1/health reports liveness, storage readiness, schema version, queue depth %, and uptime without exposing secrets or site metrics

task.title: server: ingest ring-buffer pipeline, /v1/events, /v1/events/batch, GeoIP and SIGTERM drain
task.description: Implement the bounded 16,384-event MPSC ring buffer and 1000ms/512-event flusher feeding rotameter-store-sqlite, POST /v1/events (202 Accepted) & /v1/events/batch (up to 500 events), header/MMDB GeoIP, optional Sec-GPC check, origin/rate-limit guardrails, and graceful 10s SIGTERM WAL checkpoint drain.

acceptance_criteria: POST /v1/events validates origin/site/payload and returns 202 Accepted via non-blocking try_send without waiting on SQLite fsync
Queue saturation cleanly returns 429/503 and increments rotameter_ingest_dropped_total without unbounded memory growth
Supports GeoIP header mode (CF-IPCountry/CF-Region-Code gated by trusted_proxy_headers) and optional local .mmdb lookup plus per-site respect_gpc
Graceful SIGTERM/SIGINT stops listeners, drains all buffered events within 10s, and runs WAL truncate checkpoint before exit

task.title: server: query and realtime endpoints (/v1/query, /v1/sites/{site}/realtime)
task.description: Expose POST /v1/query (JSON and text/csv) and GET /v1/sites/{site}/realtime in rotameter-server with rm_rd_/rm_adm_ auth enforcement and full integration test coverage.

acceptance_criteria: POST /v1/query validates range, granularity, filters, and limit bounds, returning the canonical summary/timeseries/rows/meta JSON envelope or CSV stream
GET /v1/sites/{site}/realtime enforces read/admin scope for the requested site_id and returns active visitors, pages, and 30m pulse
HTTP integration tests verify metric accuracy from ingest -> flush -> query for single-hit bounces, multi-page visits, UTMs, 404s, and outbound clicks

task.title: collect: <= 1.5 KB gzip collect.js and zero-JS 1x1 /v1/pixel.gif
task.description: Author the first-party browser collector (assets/collect.js) served at GET /v1/collect.js and zero-JS 43-byte transparent pixel at GET /v1/pixel.gif, gated by an automated <= 1536 B gzip size check.

acceptance_criteria: GET /v1/collect.js serves cacheable JS <= 1536 bytes gzipped (enforced by scripts/check-collector-size.sh) with zero cookies or tracking storage
Supports data-site, data-endpoint, auto pageviews, optional SPA pushState/popstate, outbound clicks, file downloads, 404 marking, rotameter_ignore opt-out, and window.rotameter(event, opts)
GET /v1/pixel.gif returns a 43-byte 1x1 transparent GIF with Cache-Control: no-store and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff while recording the hit

task.title: integrations: first-party Astro and Cloudflare Workers proxy & SSR hit helper
task.description: Deliver the zero-dependency TypeScript integration package under integrations/astro-cloudflare/ supporting first-party Worker collector/event proxying (/api/r.js + /api/e via ctx.waitUntil with Cloudflare Access Service Token headers and preview host dropping) plus trackServerHit() for pure SSR Astro routes.

acceptance_criteria: Worker proxy handlers forward CF-Connecting-IP, CF-IPCountry, CF-Region-Code, User-Agent, and CF-Access-Client-Id/Secret without blocking responses
Non-canonical hosts (e.g., *.workers.dev previews and localhost) are dropped cleanly with 204 so preview traffic never pollutes production analytics
trackServerHit() SSR helper works with zero client JS and degrades silently within a 1500 ms timeout when upstream is unreachable

task.title: client: typed HTTP client with profile config and Cloudflare Access headers
task.description: Implement rotameter-client providing typed async/blocking methods for /v1/query, /v1/sites/{site}/realtime, /v1/events/batch, /v1/health, and /v1/admin/*, plus config.toml (~/.config/rotameter/config.toml) and ROTAMETER_* / CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_* resolution.

acceptance_criteria: Resolves url, token, and CF-Access-Client-Id/Secret cleanly in precedence: CLI flags > env vars > ~/.config/rotameter/config.toml profile
Covers every /v1 endpoint with strongly typed request/response structs and mapped ErrorCode errors
Unit tests with mock HTTP server verify Access headers, bearer auth, CSV/JSON responses, and timeout/error envelopes

task.title: cli: unified rotameter binary (serve, site, key, query, realtime, import, backup, doctor)
task.description: Wire the unified feature-gated rotameter CLI (server, sqlite, mcp, tui) implementing serve, site (upsert/list/show/purge/delete), key (create/list/revoke), query, realtime (--watch), import (JSONL & CLF with --dry-run), backup (VACUUM INTO), and doctor with table/json/csv outputs and documented exit codes.

acceptance_criteria: Cargo feature flags support full build as well as slim server-only and client-only builds
All operational commands support --format table|json|csv and deterministic exit codes (0, 1, 2, 3, 4)
rotameter import ingests JSONL and Nginx/Caddy CLF files in batches with --dry-run validation; rotameter backup writes integrity-checked snapshots
rotameter doctor verifies local WAL/pragmas or remote /v1/health + Access auth cleanly

task.title: mcp: stdio read-only MCP server with analytics tool suite
task.description: Implement rotameter-mcp speaking MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio backed by rotameter-client, exposing the 7 strictly read-only analytics tools defined in SPEC-INTERFACES.md.

acceptance_criteria: Exposes rotameter_sites, rotameter_summary, rotameter_timeseries, rotameter_breakdown, rotameter_realtime, rotameter_compare_periods, and rotameter_query over stdio
Rejects/never exposes site-mutation or key-revocation tools in v1.0
Protocol integration tests validate initialize, tools/list, typed JSON schema inputs, tool calls against a live test server, and structured error responses

task.title: tui: ratatui flight-instrument dashboard with ASCII block chart and drill-down
task.description: Implement rotameter-tui using ratatui + crossterm: site switcher, 1-5 range hotkeys (24H/7D/30D/12M/ALL), 5m live ticker, KPI strip with period deltas, ASCII block chart with dense cap + today highlight + horizontal cursor scrubbing rolling the headline readout, breakdown tabs, and Enter/Esc filter drill-down.

acceptance_criteria: Renders cleanly on standard 80x24 and larger terminals without panic on terminal resize or offline/API errors
ASCII block chart renders crisp glyph columns with denser cap, highlights today bucket, and rolls headline date/visitors/pageviews while scrubbing with Left/Right or h/l
Supports s (site switch), 1-5 (ranges), Tab (PAGES/SOURCES/GEO/TECH/EVENTS), Enter (apply filter), Esc (clear filter), r (refresh), ? (help), q (quit)

task.title: ops: multi-arch musl/macOS builds, OCI image, systemd unit and Litestream R2 runbook
task.description: Configure multi-arch release builds (x86_64/aarch64 Linux static musl + Apple Silicon/Intel macOS), multi-arch OCI container image, hardened systemd unit (MemoryMax=256M, 127.0.0.1:8000), Litestream R2 replication config, and verified restore drill script under infra/.

acceptance_criteria: Release workflow/scripts build stripped static binaries for x86_64-unknown-linux-musl, aarch64-unknown-linux-musl, aarch64-apple-darwin, and x86_64-apple-darwin
Multi-arch Containerfile builds linux/amd64 and linux/arm64 minimal images running as unprivileged user
infra/ includes hardened rotameter.service (MemoryMax=256M, ProtectSystem=strict, TimeoutStopSec=15s), litestream.yml R2 template, and restore-verify script

task.title: verify: v1.0 memory, load, SIGTERM drain, rollover and cardinality release gates
task.description: Build and run the complete v1.0 release verification harness proving every SLA and safety gate in SPEC-OPERATIONS.md on 1 vCPU / 1 GB RAM limits.

acceptance_criteria: Idle RSS < 40 MB and peak RSS < 128 MB measured under 5,000 events/s 60s burst + concurrent POST /v1/query
SIGTERM drain test confirms 0 acknowledged (202) events lost across 10,000 buffered hits
Midnight 23:55 -> 00:05 UTC rollover test preserves single session/visitor under 30m grace window; 100k query-string bomb routes cleanly into (other)
1,000,000-event SQLite WAL benchmark passes 30d summary+timeseries+breakdown query at p95 < 25 ms; restore drill & Astro/CF Workers E2E test pass

task.title: v1.5: decoupled Web UI (--ui=on|off) and multi-user RBAC/OIDC
task.description: Optional static Web dashboard UI served behind --ui=on|off (default off) consuming /v1/*, paired with multi-user accounts, session auth, OIDC/SSO, and role-based site permissions.

acceptance_criteria: Default headless mode leaves --ui=off with zero UI asset overhead
Authenticated Web UI exposes summary, timeseries, breakdowns, and site/key management over /v1/*

task.title: v1.5: GTM (.tpl / sGTM) and Cloudflare Zaraz integrations
task.description: Official packaged Google Tag Manager Web custom template (.tpl), Server-Side GTM client/tag template, and Cloudflare Zaraz Managed Component targeting /v1/events.

acceptance_criteria: Packaged templates map standard pageview and custom event fields cleanly to Rotameter /v1/events

task.title: v1.5: Streamable HTTP /mcp endpoint and opt-in --allow-admin MCP tools
task.description: Optional Streamable HTTP /mcp transport on rotameter serve (--enable-mcp-http) authenticated via Bearer token, plus opt-in --allow-admin MCP mutation tools.

acceptance_criteria: Disabled by default; enabling --enable-mcp-http enforces rm_rd_ or rm_adm_ Bearer auth

task.title: v2.0: multi-step conversion funnels, user flows and retention cohorts
task.description: Product analytics capabilities built directly atop the v1.0 ordered events(site_id, session_id, seq_in_session, ts_ms) stream: ordered/unordered funnels with drop-off, page transition user flows, retention cohorts, engaged-time heartbeats, Search Console sync, and compound AND/OR/NOT + regex filter AST.

acceptance_criteria: Funnels and path transition queries execute over existing v1.0 events without requiring historical re-ingestion

task.title: v2.0: pluggable Storage adapters (Postgres, ClickHouse, DuckDB, CF Analytics Engine, MySQL)
task.description: Implement secondary Storage crate adapters for PostgreSQL, ClickHouse, DuckDB, Cloudflare Analytics Engine/D1, and MySQL/MariaDB/PlanetScale behind the v1.0 trait boundaries.

acceptance_criteria: Each backend passes the shared Storage trait conformance suite and declares accurate StorageCapabilities
